Yet, for digital creators in Nigeria, the reality is starkly different. Stripe and PayPal, the default payment gateways for most platforms, are either unavailable or severely restricted. This leaves you with two choices: accept the limitations of conventional platforms or build your own sovereign commerce infrastructure. The first option means relying on intermediaries that can shut you down without notice. The second option requires understanding the tradeoffs between renting a platform and owning your stack. This analysis compares both paths side-by-side, focusing on payment processing, fees, ownership, and automation. The goal is clear: to help you decide whether to rent or own your commerce infrastructure.

This post is part of the COREMERCH infrastructure series. For the complete foundation — every component, every configuration step, and the full deployment sequence — read the pillar guide: The Complete Guide to Selling Digital Products Without Stripe at https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/comparing-real-options-selling-digital-products-without-stripe-2. content.title: The Complete Guide to Selling Digital Products Without Stripe

content.text: What Each Option Actually Offers: Stock photos

Conventional platforms like Gumroad, Lemon Squeezy, and Paddle promise simplicity. They handle hosting, payment processing, and product delivery in exchange for a percentage of your revenue. However, they rely on Stripe or PayPal for payments, which excludes creators in restricted countries. In contrast, sovereign commerce infrastructure uses open tools like GitHub Pages, Cloudflare Workers, and NOWPayments. You own the entire stack, from hosting to payment verification. There’s no middleman. The Complete Builder Kit ($197) provides blueprints and templates to deploy this infrastructure in 48 hours. The tradeoff is clear: platforms offer convenience but control your destiny, while sovereign stacks require initial setup but grant permanent autonomy.
How They Handle Restricted Countries

Platforms like Gumroad and Paddle are built on top of Stripe and PayPal. If these payment processors exclude your country, the platform is useless to you. Even if a platform supports alternative gateways, they often require additional KYC or impose higher fees. Sovereign infrastructure bypasses this entirely. NOWPayments, for example, supports 300+ cryptocurrencies with a flat 0.5% fee and no KYC. Payments are verified on-chain, and the webhook triggers product delivery instantly. This architecture is not a workaround—it’s a base-layer solution designed for regions where conventional systems fail. You’re not begging for access; you’re building your own access.
Payment Speed, Fees, and Real Costs

Platforms typically charge 5-10% per transaction, plus payment processor fees. For a $20 stock photo, that’s $2-3 lost to intermediaries. Sovereign stacks using NOWPayments charge 0.5% for crypto payments. On networks like BSC or Solana, transaction fees are under $0.10. The real cost of sovereign infrastructure is the initial setup. The Complete Builder Kit ($197) includes all blueprints and templates, with no recurring fees. Once deployed, your stack operates indefinitely. Platforms, however, lock you into subscriptions or per-transaction fees. The choice is between paying repeatedly for rented access or investing once in owned infrastructure.
Sovereign infrastructure is not a workaround—it’s base-layer architecture.
Ownership, Automation, and Delivery

With platforms, you’re renting space on someone else’s infrastructure. They control your data, your customer relationships, and your ability to operate. Sovereign stacks give you full ownership. Your store is hosted on GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages, your backend logic runs on Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script, and your files are delivered via Google Drive or Cloudflare R2. Automation is handled through webhooks, ensuring instant product delivery the moment payment confirms. The Complete Builder Kit includes end-to-end tested templates, so you don’t need to write code from scratch. The result is a system you own, control, and can modify without asking permission.
Which Architecture to Choose Based on Your Situation

If you’re selling a single stock photo and don’t care about long-term ownership, a platform might suffice—if it’s available in your country. But if you’re building a sustainable business, sovereign infrastructure is the only option. It’s pressure-tested against currency collapse, payment rejection, and financial isolation. The Complete Builder Kit provides everything you need to deploy a fully operational stack in 48 hours. The initial setup requires effort, but the payoff is permanent autonomy. Choose rented convenience if you’re temporary. Choose owned infrastructure if you’re serious.

Your Deployment Checklist

1. Choose your hosting: GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages for static sites. 2. Set up backend logic: Use Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script for order processing. 3. Configure payment processing: Integrate NOWPayments for crypto payments with a 0.5% fee. 4. Store order data: Use Supabase or Google Sheets for lightweight databases. 5. Deliver files: Upload products to Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 for instant delivery. 6. Test end-to-end: Ensure payment verification triggers file delivery automatically. 7. Deploy and monitor: Launch your stack and track transactions without intermediaries.
Frequently Asked Questions
Can I use sovereign infrastructure if I’m not a developer?
Yes. The Complete Builder Kit includes templates and blueprints that require no coding. Follow the step-by-step guides to deploy your stack in 48 hours.
What cryptocurrencies does NOWPayments support?
NOWPayments supports over 300 cryptocurrencies, including Bitcoin, Ethereum, Binance Coin, and stablecoins like USDT. Recommended networks for low fees are BSC, Solana, and TRON.
How do I handle refunds with crypto payments?
Refunds are processed manually by sending the equivalent amount back to the buyer’s wallet. The system doesn’t automate refunds, but the process is straightforward and transparent.
Can I scale my store after deployment?
Yes. The Complete Builder Kit includes a scaling playbook to handle increased traffic and product volume. Your stack is designed to grow with your business.
What happens if NOWPayments goes down?
NOWPayments operates as a payment processor, not a custodian. Even if their service is unavailable, your store remains operational. Payments are verified on-chain, ensuring continuity.
